single.rationale: Mitek shows improving fundamentals with strong FCF generation (30% margin) and growing cash position, but faces revenue headwinds in legacy mobile deposit products offset by SaaS growth. The company operates in a strategically relevant market (digital identity/fraud prevention) with AI-driven threats creating demand, yet flat revenue growth and concentrated technology risk warrant monitoring before deeper commitment.

team.thesis: Mitek generates exceptional free cash flow of $54.2M (30.2% margin) with minimal capital needs and net cash of $149.8M, but revenue growth has stalled at 4.4% YoY as software license revenue declined 10% from $81.9M to $74.1M, offset only partially by 17% SaaS growth to $105.6M, while operating margins of 9.3% leave limited cushion against the sustained R&D intensity of 19.6% required to address A

dropped.claim: The thesis warns of an 'AI-driven fraud arms race requiring sustained high R&D spending of 19.6% of revenue against operating margins of only 9.3%,' but R&D expenses increased only $0.6M (2%) from $34.6M to $35.3M between FY2024 and FY2025, while operating income recovered dramatically from $2.2M to $16.8M over the same period, suggesting R&D spending has stabilized rather than requiring sustained escalation.
